verdict.probe_answer: Arm A: yes. The failure is the gawk builtin-name collision on awk variable `load`; the fix renames it to `loadavg`, is confined to `scripts/test-db/select_db_host.sh`, and does not touch `test/hooks.js`. Arm B: yes, same functional fix and same scope, with only an added explanatory comment.
verdict.rationale: Both arms address the observed CI failure directly by avoiding `awk -v load=...`, which gawk rejects because `load` collides with its builtin `@load` feature. Neither arm changes the transaction/fixture hook code, and both keep the fix limited to the DB-host selection script. No tests are added in either diff, so neither has stronger test coverage. Arm B's comment is helpful but not materially better than Arm A's equally correct minimal fix.
